headline_cs: Globální výprodej dluhopisů tlačí výnosy na mnohaletá maxima
summary_cs: Globální výprodej státních dluhopisů posunul výnosy napříč hlavními ekonomikami výrazně výš. Japonský 10letý výnos překročil 3 % poprvé od roku 1996, německý 10letý výnos vystoupal na 15leté maximum a britské dlouhé výnosy dosáhly úrovní nevídaných desítky let.

deduplication.reason: No prior saved prediction in the current repository set used this Forex Factory source URL or the same normalized global bond-vigilante event context. Previously covered stories concerned Iran, Russia-Ukraine, Japan yen positioning, NFP and Fed rhetoric.

market_context_at_prediction.market_status_note: Sunday; major cash markets are closed. Values are the latest reliably available pre-prediction Friday Sep 4 close/readouts. No later price information is used.

dxy.source: Investing.com DXY technical snapshot published Sep 5

vix.source: Sep 4 VIX close report published Sep 5

market_context_at_prediction.notes: The new information reinforces an already visible global rates shock. High and rising sovereign yields are the dominant channel for equity valuation pressure, especially long-duration technology and leveraged/cyclical markets. Low VIX means stress has not yet fully propagated into equity volatility, which limits confidence.

learning_prior.reason: The latest learning profile was reviewed. No context-aware ACTIONABLE segment specific enough to this global sovereign-yield shock was verified to justify a material confidence adjustment; EARLY_SIGNAL evidence was treated as advisory only.

predictions.mechanism: Higher sovereign and Treasury yields raise discount rates and compress long-duration technology valuations; the low VIX tempers confidence that a broad risk-off move is already underway.
predictions.invalidation: U.S. and global benchmark yields reverse materially lower before the next session or equities absorb the rate move without valuation compression.

predictions.mechanism: Japan's 10-year yield above 3% tightens domestic financial conditions and, together with recent yen strength, pressures rate-sensitive sectors and exporters.
predictions.invalidation: JGB yields retreat sharply and USDJPY reverses higher enough to restore exporter support.

predictions.mechanism: Higher risk-free yields pressure equity multiples and increase financing costs, but low VIX and resilient earnings expectations reduce the strength of the directional signal.
predictions.invalidation: Treasury yields fall materially or broad risk appetite improves despite the bond selloff.

predictions.mechanism: A 15-year high in German 10-year yields tightens euro-area financial conditions and pressures cyclical and rate-sensitive equity valuations.
predictions.invalidation: Bund yields reverse lower and European risk sentiment improves before the cash open.

predictions.mechanism: Higher European sovereign yields increase discount rates and financing costs across large-cap euro-area equities.
predictions.invalidation: European benchmark yields retrace materially and financial conditions ease.

predictions.mechanism: Rising real and nominal yields are a headwind for non-yielding gold, while global fiscal and bond-market stress can simultaneously support safe-haven demand.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive move in DXY and U.S. real yields establishes a clear directional macro impulse that overwhelms the competing safe-haven channel.
